correctness.rationale: Exact endpoint-degree calculation yields all possible occupancy pairs: one-sided arbitrary and (1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2) only. It gives the face coefficients ab, t(a+b-2), C(t,2). Extension checks give precisely two whole parts, (a-t)(b-t) unmatched cross pairs, t(a+b-2t) triples, and C(t,2) four-endpoint facets. Exhaustive independent adjacency checks over 78 profiles and 83,456 subsets reproduce both polynomials; finite checks support but do not replace the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: A naturally parameterized near-complete bipartite family interpolates from bicliques (t=0) to crown graphs (t=min(a,b)). The two full polynomials determine all faces and all facets of the induced P_3-free complex, reveal exact appearance/disappearance of size-2 and size-3 facets under edge deletions, and prove a growing interval of absent maximal-set sizes in connected regular crown graphs. The invariant and graph family are standard and the structural gap persists for arbitrarily many orders; this is more than a numerical extremum or a routine reparameterization.
